verdict.rationale: Runpod docs confirm term-based commitments ('Commit to a 3-month or 6-month term upfront for significant discounts on compute costs') which directly matches reserved/committed-use pricing for Pods, but this is only briefly mentioned with no detail on discount tiers, cluster/serverless applicability, or contractual terms. Missing for 10: specifics on discount percentages, whether commitments apply to Instant Clusters/Serverless, capacity guarantee terms, and independent/community confirmation of the commitment program working as advertised.
